sql_by_query.q_0aa8328a6096cd1633362998: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_don_hang = 'DA_HUY') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "order_cancellation_rate" FROM silver.don_hang AS t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t1 ON t0.co_so_ma = t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t1.thanh_pho = 'Hồ Chí Minh') AND (t0.trang_thai_don_hang IN ('HOAN_THANH', 'DA_HUY')) AND (t0.ngay_tao >= DATE '2026-09-01') AND (t0.ngay_tao < DATE '2026-10-01') LIMIT 2
sql_by_query.q_332502f988651c1246415411: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_giao_hang = 'DELIVERED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "delivery_success_rate" FROM silver.giao_hang AS t0 JOIN silver.don_hang AS t1 ON t0.ma_don_hang = t1.ma_don_hang JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t2 ON t1.co_so_ma = t2.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t2.thanh_pho = 'Hồ Chí Minh') AND (t0.trang_thai_giao_hang IN ('DELIVERED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')) AND (t0.thoi_gian_nhan_chuyen >= DATE '2026-09-01') AND (t0.thoi_gian_nhan_chuyen < DATE '2026-10-01') LIMIT 2

sql_by_query.q_25d0e62bd2a64d52732223b4: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_giao_hang = 'DELIVERED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "delivery_success_rate" FROM silver.giao_hang AS t0 JOIN silver.don_hang AS t1 ON t0.ma_don_hang = t1.ma_don_hang JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t2 ON t1.co_so_ma = t2.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t2.thanh_pho IN ('Hồ Chí Minh')) AND (t0.trang_thai_giao_hang IN ('DELIVERED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')) AND (t0.thoi_gian_nhan_chuyen >= DATE '2026-09-01') AND (t0.thoi_gian_nhan_chuyen < DATE '2026-10-01') LIMIT 2
sql_by_query.q_6069a1d2d5d5f2dce619bc13: SELECT t1.ten_chi_nhanh AS "store", t1.ma_chi_nhanh AS "store_id", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_don_hang = 'DA_HUY') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "order_cancellation_rate" FROM silver.don_hang AS t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t1 ON t0.co_so_ma = t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t1.thanh_pho IN ('Hồ Chí Minh')) AND (t0.trang_thai_don_hang IN ('HOAN_THANH', 'DA_HUY')) AND (t0.ngay_tao >= DATE '2026-09-01') AND (t0.ngay_tao < DATE '2026-10-01') GROUP BY t1.ten_chi_nhanh, t1.ma_chi_nhanh ORDER BY "store" ASC NULLS LAST, "store_id" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50001
sql_by_query.q_8262b47f549ffd558ee65c16: SELECT t1.ten_chi_nhanh AS "store", t1.ma_chi_nhanh AS "store_id", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_cham_cong = 'DI_TRE') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "late_shift_rate" FROM silver.ca_lam_viec_nhan_vien AS t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t1 ON t0.co_so_ma = t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t1.thanh_pho IN ('Hồ Chí Minh')) AND (t0.trang_thai_cham_cong IN ('DUNG_GIO', 'DI_TRE', 'VE_SOM')) AND (t0.ngay_lam_viec >= DATE '2026-09-01') AND (t0.ngay_lam_viec < DATE '2026-10-01') GROUP BY t1.ten_chi_nhanh, t1.ma_chi_nhanh ORDER BY "store" ASC NULLS LAST, "store_id" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50001
sql_by_query.q_8b89a232b3e4c1152dfa9cdf: SELECT t1.ten_chi_nhanh AS "store", t1.ma_chi_nhanh AS "store_id", COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT t0.dang_kinh_doanh IS TRUE) AS "paused_sale_positions" FROM silver.ton_kho_san_pham AS t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t1 ON t0.co_so_ma = t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t1.thanh_pho IN ('Hồ Chí Minh')) GROUP BY t1.ten_chi_nhanh, t1.ma_chi_nhanh ORDER BY "store" ASC NULLS LAST, "store_id" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50001
sql_by_query.q_b1ab0d34325f99b53dac4bda: SELECT t1.ten_chi_nhanh AS "store", t1.ma_chi_nhanh AS "store_id", COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.chenh_lech > 500000 OR t0.chenh_lech < -500000) AS "large_cash_discrepancy_shift_count" FROM silver.ca_doi_soat AS t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t1 ON t0.co_so_ma = t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t1.thanh_pho IN ('Hồ Chí Minh')) AND (t0.ngay_tao >= DATE '2026-09-01') AND (t0.ngay_tao < DATE '2026-10-01') GROUP BY t1.ten_chi_nhanh, t1.ma_chi_nhanh ORDER BY "store" ASC NULLS LAST, "store_id" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50001
sql_by_query.q_e1f89f588cb554b8efca1579: SELECT t1.ten_chi_nhanh AS "store", t1.ma_chi_nhanh AS "store_id", ROUND(AVG(t0.so_sao), 2) AS "avg_store_rating" FROM silver.danh_gia_chi_nhanh AS t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t1 ON t0.ma_chi_nhanh = t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t1.thanh_pho IN ('Hồ Chí Minh')) AND (t0.ngay_tao >= DATE '2026-09-01') AND (t0.ngay_tao < DATE '2026-10-01') GROUP BY t1.ten_chi_nhanh, t1.ma_chi_nhanh ORDER BY "store" ASC NULLS LAST, "store_id" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50001
sql_by_query.q_e9518e350b412f6e2be5a832: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_cham_cong = 'DI_TRE') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "late_shift_rate" FROM silver.ca_lam_viec_nhan_vien AS t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t1 ON t0.co_so_ma = t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t1.thanh_pho IN ('Hồ Chí Minh')) AND (t0.trang_thai_cham_cong IN ('DUNG_GIO', 'DI_TRE', 'VE_SOM')) AND (t0.ngay_lam_viec >= DATE '2026-09-01') AND (t0.ngay_lam_viec < DATE '2026-10-01') LIMIT 2
sql_by_query.q_f1abcaa54f995997add99272: SELECT t2.ten_chi_nhanh AS "store", t2.ma_chi_nhanh AS "store_id", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_giao_hang = 'DELIVERED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "delivery_success_rate" FROM silver.giao_hang AS t0 JOIN silver.don_hang AS t1 ON t0.ma_don_hang = t1.ma_don_hang JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t2 ON t1.co_so_ma = t2.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t2.thanh_pho IN ('Hồ Chí Minh')) AND (t0.trang_thai_giao_hang IN ('DELIVERED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')) AND (t0.thoi_gian_nhan_chuyen >= DATE '2026-09-01') AND (t0.thoi_gian_nhan_chuyen < DATE '2026-10-01') GROUP BY t2.ten_chi_nhanh, t2.ma_chi_nhanh ORDER BY "store" ASC NULLS LAST, "store_id" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50001
sql_by_query.q_fdddae565e2b304bdb2890e3: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t0.trang_thai_don_hang = 'DA_HUY') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "order_cancellation_rate" FROM silver.don_hang AS t0 JOIN silver.chi_nhanh AS t1 ON t0.co_so_ma = t1.ma_chi_nhanh WHERE (t1.thanh_pho IN ('Hồ Chí Minh')) AND (t0.trang_thai_don_hang IN ('HOAN_THANH', 'DA_HUY')) AND (t0.ngay_tao >= DATE '2026-09-01') AND (t0.ngay_tao < DATE '2026-10-01') LIMIT 2
